phase_name: Wire both single-task Stage 5 sites and delete the broken clobber

objectives.description: skill-orchestrate Stage 5 implemented) case wired, recover_json reuse guard
Delete broken CHECKPOINT 2 clobber in commands/orchestrate.md

approaches_tried.approach: Used "${completion_json:-{}}" inline bash default-value idiom as sketched in the plan
approaches_tried.reason: bash parameter-expansion default-word matching stops at the first unescaped '}', so this idiom appends a stray trailing '}' to any non-empty completion_json, corrupting the JSON and forcing every downstream jq call to fail closed to empty string via 2>/dev/null -- would have silently defeated the entire fix on every real invocation. Caught by a functional simulation against a fixture, not just bash -n. Replaced with the two-step '[ -z ... ] && completion_json="{}"' idiom in both skill-orchestrate and skill-orchestrate-hard.

notes: Discovered the same pre-existing (not introduced by this task) buggy "${recover_json:-{}}" idiom already in production at skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md:562 and skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md:823 (diagnostic-only 'recovered_reported_status' logging -- low impact, always silently falls back to "unknown"). Out of scope for this task's file list; flagged in the final summary as a follow-up candidate alongside the commands/implement.md sibling defect found in Phase 3.
